messages:
meera: FYI escalated from CS — customer RepliQ (Dedicated, us-east) seeing intermittent tool/function calls return args=null after model v18.2 canary. ~25% of tool responses show valid tool name but args are null. customer noticed after today's rollout :frowning:

alex: Can you paste a redacted sample request + response?

meera: Pasted below (redacted):
```
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "model": "redwood-infer/v18.2",
  "input": "Find docs for widget X",
  "tools": ["search"]
}
--- response ---
{
  "choice": {
    "tool_calls": [ { "name": "search", "args": null } ]
  }
}
```

jordan: Is this happening only for Dedicated tenants or on Hosted too? Any auth failures noted?

meera: Only reported for RepliQ dedicated pool so far. No 401s or billing errors. Customer says requests look identical to previous days.

eng-bot: Canary metrics alert: v18.2 canary cohort c-3902 shows schema_reject rate up 0.7% -> 3.4% in last 60m. Tool-invoke p95 latency increased 120ms -> 240ms during same window. KV cache hit rate dipped 4%.

alex: Quick hypothesis: something in the v18.2 call-resolver path is dropping arg payload when a tokenization normalization edgecase occurs (zero-width spaces, uncommon unicode). Could also be a change in the tool-arg encoder/decoder.

meera: Customer insists input is plain ascii. They pasted the original client payload; no hidden chars.

jordan: Can someone share a repro script? If we can reproduce we can test rollback vs patch.

alex: Repro script (local v18.2 container):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.reed/ v1/invoke -d '{"model":"redwood-infer/v18.2","input":"search: widget X","tools":["search"]}' 
```
I ran this 200x and ~27 calls returned args:null. Attaching logs: resolver path shows JSON parse OK but then arg blob gets nulled before send to tool.

jordan: I see a correlated fallback event in the runtime: when batching heuristics decide to collapse prefix cache (burst mode), we route via legacy resolver for compatibility; that path may treat non-string arg payloads differently. Could be a selector regression.

ops: I'm seeing a small spike in queue latency for that dedicated pool (us-east-2) matching timestamps. Might be autoscale thrash causing fallback.

alex: Confirmed locally: forcing single-threaded processing on v18.2 reproduces null args less frequently. So two things: (1) concurrency/batching interaction; (2) a model-side wire-format behavior change that surfaces under that concurrency.

meera: Customer impact: several failed workflows, some billing-sensitive retries. They're asking for immediate mitigation.

jordan: Proposed mitigations:
- Disable v18.2 for RepliQ tenant (pin them to v18.1)
- Pause canary rollout for Dedicated until patch
- Backport fix for arg-decoder in runtime and release v18.2.1

ops: Rolling back model for tenant c-7732 now. Running rollout command: `/infra/rollout pin c-7732 redwood-infer/v18.1`

ops: ops-bot: rollback requested by ops. Deploy window immediate. Rolling back model assignment for tenant c-7732 — started. :gear:

eng-bot: Canary cohort c-3902: traffic for v18.2 reduced to 0% for affected dedicated pools. Monitoring for error rate drop.

meera: RepliQ confirmed they see tool args populated again on a quick smoke test. Customer appreciative and asking for RCA.

alex: Root cause summary (prelim): arg-serialization compatibility regression triggered when resolver path fell back under concurrency/batching changes introduced in v18.2. Patch landed in local branch: `fix/arg-decode-compat` (PR #7890). Will backport to v18.2.x.

jordan: Action items:
- eng-runtime: backport fix + run dedicated regression test matrix (jordan, alex)
- infra/ops: hold canary for Dedicated pools until patch (ops)
- cs/meera: send templated update to RepliQ + offer dedicated support window
- oncall: watch canary metrics for 24h post-patch

ops: ops-bot: rollback complete for tenant c-7732 at 3529876902.

meera: Confirmed with RepliQ at 3529876958 — all good, they're unblocked. They asked to be notified before v18.2 re-roll.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-089: "v18.2 tool-arg nullification under resolver fallback". Linked to PR #7890 and runbook entry.

alex: I'll produce a short RCA draft and attach timeline + repro steps. Planning v18.2.1 release once tests pass.

meera: Thanks team. Closing loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Marking canary paused for Dedicated. Will reopen when patch released.

ops: Adding postmortem notes to internal doc: /docs/incidents/INC-2026-089.

meera: Customer said "thanks for fast response" and will wait for the patch notice. End of thread.
